title: LATAM STG 2 — FINAL v2
subtitle: Document Delivery — Supervisora Antonela delivers the falsified 'carta de desembarque' at 22:59
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport, Santiago, Chile
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential
violations_cited: CPCL Art. 197 — Falsificación en instrumento privado
CHIPENCOD Art. 211 — Calumnia (false imputation of crime: aggression)
LPDC Art. 3(b) — Right to truthful and timely information
LPDC Art. 23 bis — Mandatory written notice of denied boarding reasons (truthfulness)
CACH Art. 131 — Duty to inform passenger of rights
LPDC Art. 3(e) — Right to compensation for denied boarding

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Supervisora Antonela delivers the 'carta de desembarque' containing three written allegations, all disproven hours earlier by PDI CCTV review (STG‑7).
Antonela refuses to acknowledge the PDI finding and claims 'no podemos cambiar la información que tenemos' – directly contradicting Diego’s instruction to 'ajustar' the letter (STG‑29).
The document’s allegation of 'agresiona al personal de la latam' constitutes a false imputation of a crime (calumnia) after PDI confirmed no aggression occurred.
Delivery of the falsified document completes the fabrication pipeline orchestrated by Diego in STG‑29, establishing the full evidentiary chain for CPCL Art. 197.
